# Webflow Migration Expert. Your rankings stay put.

As a **certified Webflow migration expert**, I move websites from WordPress, Wix, Framer, Squarespace and 10+ other platforms to Webflow, pixel-perfect, with every URL mapped and 301 redirected so your SEO survives the move. You work directly with me, not an account manager.

## Webflow migration and website projects

- [DC construction company](https://www.simanbuilds.com/): Webflow migration. Full website migration to Webflow with 301 redirects and meta data carried over.
- [Los Angeles preschool](https://boulevardschool.com/): Design from scratch. Design, copy and Figma to Webflow build with WCAG and ADA accessibility.
- [Laundromat franchise brand](https://www.laundrolabusa.com/): Webflow CMS. Marketing and franchise websites for a brand in 23+ regions.
- [Accessibility company](https://www.scribely.com/): WCAG and speed. Accessibility and performance work for a Forbes Accessibility 200 company.
- [Playground safety company](https://playgroundmedic.pages.dev/): Design from scratch. Website design, build and copy that turns visitors into booked calls.

## Hi, I'm Damir, your Webflow migration expert

For the past 5 years I've built websites for solo founders, small businesses and mid-size companies, and Webflow is where I do my best work. I've completed 40+ migrations to Webflow and plan every one around protecting the rankings you've already earned.

I've also been the main Webflow developer for three marketing agencies, and the Webflow engineer working alongside the software team at an online real estate listings company. So I build sites marketers can update on their own and developers are happy to work with.

## Why most website migrations quietly fail

The new site looks great on launch day. Then old links return 404s, rankings slide and the contact form stops sending leads. A Webflow migration expert plans for every one of these before anything moves.

**The problem**

### Old URLs break

Pages people and Google link to return 404s.

**My fix**

A full URL audit and a 301 redirect map, tested before launch.

**The problem**

### Rankings drop

Titles, descriptions and alt text get lost in the move.

**My fix**

Meta data, canonicals and schema carried over page by page.

**The problem**

### Leads stop coming in

Forms, CRM links and tracking break silently.

**My fix**

Forms, CRM and analytics reconnected and tested.

**The problem**

### Problems go unnoticed

Crawl errors pile up for weeks after launch.

**My fix**

Google Search Console set up and monitored after launch.

## My Webflow migration process, built around your rankings

Five steps, the same on every project, so nothing gets lost between your old website and the new one.

1. **Audit and URL map**: Crawl every page, list every URL and plan the redirects before anything moves.
2. **Pixel-perfect rebuild**: Your current design rebuilt in Webflow, or a new one, with a clean class system.
3. **CMS import**: Blog posts, case studies and collections moved into Webflow CMS in bulk.
4. **SEO and redirects**: 301 redirects, meta data, alt text, canonicals, schema and page speed, all checked.
5. **Launch and monitor**: Launch QA, Google Search Console monitoring and handover training for your team.

## Why hire a Webflow migration expert

A migration is a one-time move with long-term SEO consequences. It pays to have someone who has done it 40+ times plan it with you.

| Criteria | Webflow migration expert | Typical agency | Doing it yourself |
|---|---|---|---|
| Who you talk to | The person doing the work | Usually an account manager | Webflow docs and forums |
| Redirect planning | Every URL mapped before launch | Depends on the team | Easy to miss pages |
| Migration experience | 40+ Webflow migrations | Varies by project | Usually your first |
| After launch | Search Console monitoring and handover training | Often a paid add-on | You watch for problems |

## Webflow migration questions, answered

 Send it with your quote request.

### What does a Webflow migration expert do?

A Webflow migration expert plans and runs the whole move to Webflow: auditing your current site, rebuilding it in Webflow, importing CMS content, setting up 301 redirects and SEO, and monitoring Google Search Console after launch.

### Will I lose my Google rankings when I migrate to Webflow?

Protecting them is the point of the process. Every URL is mapped and redirected, meta data and alt text are carried over, and Search Console is monitored after launch to catch crawl errors early.

### How long does a Webflow migration take?

Most Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks to finish. The exact timeline depends on your page count, CMS items and whether you are redesigning, and you get it with your quote before any work starts.

### Can we redesign the website during the migration?

Yes. Your current design can be rebuilt pixel-perfect, or a new design can be created and built in Webflow as part of the move.

### Can you migrate my blog and CMS content to Webflow?

Yes. Blog posts, case studies and other collections are imported into Webflow CMS in bulk, with their URLs and SEO fields intact.

### How much does a Webflow migration cost?

Every site is different, so I quote after reviewing yours. Send your current URL below and you get a scope, timeline and price.

## What does a Drupal to Webflow migration expert do?

**Quick answer**

A Drupal to Webflow migration expert plans and runs the whole move for you so nothing breaks. A Drupal to Webflow migration maps Drupal content types, fields and taxonomies to Webflow CMS collections, exports and imports the content, rebuilds views and templates in Webflow, moves multilingual content to Webflow Localization where needed, carries over SEO settings and adds 301 redirects for every URL alias. Timelines depend on content size; many Drupal to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks.

## Questions about hiring a Drupal to Webflow migration expert

### Why hire a Drupal to Webflow migration expert instead of doing it yourself?

Most traffic lost in a migration comes from broken URLs and missing SEO data, not from the design. A Drupal to Webflow migration expert maps every URL, sets up 301 redirects, carries over titles, descriptions and alt text, and watches Google Search Console after launch, so your rankings survive the move.

### Can Webflow handle a large Drupal site?

Often yes. Webflow CMS item limits depend on your plan, so I check your content volume during the audit and recommend the right setup.

### Will I lose SEO moving from Drupal to Webflow?

No, with a full redirect plan. Every URL alias gets a 301 redirect and your metatags are carried over.

### How long does a Drupal to Webflow migration take?

Many Drupal to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks. Larger sites can take longer, and you get an exact timeline with your quote.

### Can you migrate multilingual Drupal sites?

Yes. Translated content can move to Webflow Localization.

### What happens to Drupal views?

Views are rebuilt as Webflow collection lists with filtering and sorting.

Most Duda to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks.

## Questions about hiring a Duda to Webflow migration expert

### Why hire a Duda to Webflow migration expert instead of doing it yourself?

Most traffic lost in a migration comes from broken URLs and missing SEO data, not from the design. A Duda to Webflow migration expert maps every URL, sets up 301 redirects, carries over titles, descriptions and alt text, and watches Google Search Console after launch, so your rankings survive the move.

### Can I export my Duda site to Webflow?

There's no direct export to Webflow. The design is rebuilt in Webflow and content is moved into Webflow CMS.

### Will I lose SEO moving from Duda to Webflow?

No, with a proper redirect plan and SEO settings carried over.

### How long does a Duda to Webflow migration take?

### Will my Framer animations work in Webflow?

Yes. Animations are recreated with Webflow Interactions or GSAP to match the original feel as closely as possible.

### Will I lose SEO moving from Framer to Webflow?

No, as long as URLs and SEO settings are handled carefully. Every changed URL gets a 301 redirect and all page SEO settings are carried over.

Most Framer to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks, depending on page count, CMS size and animation complexity.

| SEO settings | Meta titles, descriptions and social images carried over. |
| Members and newsletter | Reviewed during the audit: Webflow has no built-in newsletter, so this is planned with an integration. |

## Ghost migration problems I solve before they cost you traffic

**Problem 01**

### Root-level post URLs

Ghost posts at /post-slug/ can't sit at the root in Webflow CMS. Every post gets a mapped 301 redirect to /blog/post-slug.

**Problem 02**

### Members and paid subscriptions

Webflow has no built-in newsletter or paid membership. I plan the right integration during the audit, so your subscribers aren't lost.

**Problem 03**

### Card content

Ghost cards for embeds, galleries and callouts need careful conversion into Webflow rich text.

## How I run your Ghost to Webflow migration

The same five steps on every project, so nothing gets lost along the way.

1. **Audit and URL map**: Crawl every Ghost page, list every URL and plan the redirects before anything moves.
2. **Pixel-perfect rebuild**: Your current design rebuilt in Webflow, or a new one, with a clean class system.
3. **CMS import**: Blog posts, case studies and collections moved into Webflow CMS in bulk.
4. **SEO and redirects**: 301 redirects, meta data, alt text, canonicals, schema and page speed, all checked.
5. **Launch and monitor**: Launch QA, Google Search Console monitoring and handover training for your team.

## What does a Ghost to Webflow migration expert do?

**Quick answer**

A Ghost to Webflow migration expert plans and runs the whole move for you so nothing breaks. A Ghost to Webflow migration exports your Ghost content as JSON, imports posts, tags and authors into Webflow CMS collections, rebuilds the theme in Webflow, carries over SEO settings and adds 301 redirects. Ghost posts usually live at the root (/post-slug/) while Webflow CMS items live under a collection path (/blog/post-slug), so every post needs a mapped redirect. Most Ghost to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks.

## Questions about hiring a Ghost to Webflow migration expert

### Why hire a Ghost to Webflow migration expert instead of doing it yourself?

Most traffic lost in a migration comes from broken URLs and missing SEO data, not from the design. A Ghost to Webflow migration expert maps every URL, sets up 301 redirects, carries over titles, descriptions and alt text, and watches Google Search Console after launch, so your rankings survive the move.

### Can I import my Ghost posts into Webflow?

Yes. Ghost exports content as JSON, which is converted and imported into Webflow CMS with posts, tags and authors.

### Will I lose SEO moving from Ghost to Webflow?

No, with a full redirect plan. Every post URL is mapped to its new Webflow URL with a 301 redirect.

### What happens to my Ghost newsletter and members?

Webflow doesn't include a newsletter or paid membership system, so I plan an integration during the audit to keep your subscribers.

### How long does a Ghost to Webflow migration take?

Most Ghost to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks.

### Can my posts keep the same URLs?

Post URLs usually change because Webflow CMS items live under a collection path, so each old URL gets a 301 redirect to protect rankings.

## Questions about hiring a Shopify to Webflow migration expert

### Why hire a Shopify to Webflow migration expert instead of doing it yourself?

Most traffic lost in a migration comes from broken URLs and missing SEO data, not from the design. A Shopify to Webflow migration expert maps every URL, sets up 301 redirects, carries over titles, descriptions and alt text, and watches Google Search Console after launch, so your rankings survive the move.

### Can Webflow replace Shopify?

For smaller catalogs, Webflow Ecommerce can replace Shopify. For larger stores, many brands keep Shopify for checkout and use Webflow for the brand and content site.

### Will I lose SEO moving from Shopify to Webflow?

No, with a proper redirect plan. Every product, collection and page URL that changes gets a 301 redirect, and SEO settings are carried over.

# Webflow 301 Redirect Generator

Paste your old URLs or sitemap and get a bulk 301 redirect map for Webflow in seconds. New paths and wildcard rules are suggested for you, chains and duplicates are flagged, and you can export a CSV.

## How to add 301 redirects in Webflow

Once your redirect map is ready, adding it to Webflow takes a few minutes. Redirects only go live after you publish.

1. **Open Site settings** for your Webflow project from the dashboard or the Designer.
2. **Go to the Publishing tab** and scroll to the 301 redirects section.
3. **Enter the old path** exactly as it appears in the generator, starting with a slash, without the domain.
4. **Enter the redirect to path**, the new page on your Webflow site, and click Add redirect path.
5. **Publish your site**, then open a few old URLs in a private window to confirm each one lands on the right page in one hop.

## Webflow wildcard redirect examples

Webflow supports pattern redirects with capture groups, so one rule can cover a whole folder. Use (.*) to capture part of the old URL and %1, %2 and so on to reuse it in the new path. Test a few URLs after publishing.

| What you want | Old path | Redirect to |
|---|---|---|
| Move a whole blog folder | /news/(.*) | /blog/%1 |
| WordPress dated posts into a Webflow CMS collection | /(\d{4})/(\d{2})/(.*) | /blog/%3 |
| WordPress category pages | /category/(.*) | /blog/category/%1 |
| Rename a section of the site | /our-work/(.*) | /case-studies/%1 |

Moving a specific platform? See the [WordPress to Webflow](https://webflowmigrationexpert.com/wordpress-to-webflow-migration-expert), [Wix to Webflow](https://webflowmigrationexpert.com/wix-to-webflow-migration-expert) and [Squarespace to Webflow](https://webflowmigrationexpert.com/squarespace-to-webflow-migration-expert) migration guides.

## How to use this tool

1. **Paste your old URLs**: One per line, full URLs or paths. You can also paste your whole sitemap.xml and the tool pulls out every URL.
2. **Set your URL rules**: Choose how new paths are suggested: no trailing slashes, no .html, lowercase, dated posts into a CMS collection, plus your own folder rules.
3. **Review and edit**: Edit any new path in the table. Duplicates, redirect chains and loops are flagged so you can fix them before launch.
4. **Export to Webflow**: Download the CSV or copy it, then add each row in Webflow under Site settings, Publishing, 301 redirects.

## Questions, answered

Also try the free [Webflow Migration SEO Checklist](https://webflowmigrationexpert.com/webflow-migration-checklist).

### How do I set up redirects when moving from WordPress to Webflow?

Export every URL from your WordPress sitemap, paste them into this generator and turn on the dated posts option with your Webflow blog collection path. Then add the redirects in Webflow, using one wildcard rule for dated posts where possible.

### What is a 301 redirect in Webflow?

A 301 redirect permanently sends visitors and search engines from an old URL to a new one. In Webflow you add them under Site settings, Publishing, 301 redirects, with the old path on the left and the new path on the right.

### Do I need 301 redirects when I migrate to Webflow?

Yes, for every URL that changes. Without them, old links and Google results lead to 404 pages and the rankings those pages earned are lost. URLs that stay exactly the same don't need a redirect.

### Can one Webflow redirect cover many URLs?

Yes. Webflow supports pattern redirects with capture groups, such as /(\d{4})/(\d{2})/(.*) to /blog/%3, which moves every dated WordPress post into a blog collection with one rule. The tool suggests this when it finds dated posts.

### What are redirect chains and why avoid them?

A chain is when a redirect points to a URL that redirects again. Each extra hop slows the page and can dilute SEO value, so every old URL should redirect straight to its final new path. The tool flags chains and loops.

### Is my data uploaded anywhere?

No. The tool runs entirely in your browser. Your URLs are never sent to a server.

# Webflow Migration SEO Checklist

The SEO website migration checklist for Webflow: 25 steps to move your site without losing Google rankings, from the URL audit to Search Console after launch. Your progress is saved as you go.

## Before the migration

- **Crawl the old site** List every live URL, including blog posts, categories, tags, landing pages and PDFs.
- **Export your top pages** Pull your highest-traffic and most-linked pages from Google Search Console and Analytics.
- **Save current SEO data** Record titles, meta descriptions, H1s, alt text and canonical tags for every page.
- **Benchmark rankings and traffic** Note current positions for your key terms so you can compare after launch.
- **Back up the old site** Keep a full export of content and media before anything changes.

## Build in Webflow

- **Plan the URL structure** Keep URLs the same wherever you can. Only change them with a clear reason.
- **Set up CMS collections** Blog posts, categories, authors and case studies with matching fields.
- **Import CMS content** Bulk import via CSV, then spot-check formatting, images and internal links.
- **Recreate forms and integrations** Forms, CRM connections, booking tools and tracking scripts.
- **Build responsive layouts** Check desktop, tablet and mobile before the content review.

## SEO setup

- **Carry over titles and descriptions** Page by page, plus dynamic SEO fields on CMS templates.
- **Add alt text to every image** Including CMS images and background images that carry meaning.
- **Set canonical tags** Set the global canonical URL in Webflow and check key pages.
- **Add structured data** Organization, breadcrumbs, FAQ and article schema where it fits.
- **Check page speed** Compress images, lazy load below the fold and limit custom scripts.

## Launch

- **Add every 301 redirect** Map each old URL that changes to its new path in Webflow's 301 redirects.
- **Test the redirects** Visit a sample of old URLs, top pages first, and confirm one clean 301 hop.
- **Connect the domain and SSL** Point DNS to Webflow and confirm the secure version loads.
- **Check robots.txt and indexing** Make sure the live site isn't blocked from search engines.
- **Submit the new sitemap** Submit sitemap.xml in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.

## After launch

- **Monitor Search Console daily** Watch for crawl errors and 404s for the first two weeks.
- **Fix any 404s fast** Add missing redirects as soon as broken URLs show up.
- **Update important backlinks** Ask sites linking to you to point at the new URLs where they changed.
- **Compare rankings and traffic** Check against your benchmark after two and four weeks.
- **Train your team** Show editors how to update pages and CMS items without breaking layouts.

Your progress is saved in this browser, so you can come back to it anytime.

## Extra checks for your current platform

The 25 steps above apply to every website migration. Each platform also has its own traps. These are the ones to add to your checklist.

### WordPress to Webflow

- Date-based and nested URLs
- Shortcodes and page builder markup
- Plugin features

### Wix to Webflow

- No export button
- Wix URL patterns
- Images hosted on Wix

### Framer to Webflow

- Animation parity
- Components and variants
- CMS structure

### Squarespace to Webflow

- Partial export
- Image links
- URL structure

### HubSpot to Webflow

- Breaking lead flow
- HubL modules
- Blog URL changes

### Shopify to Webflow

- Choosing the wrong setup
- Product URL redirects
- Variants and options

## How to use this tool

1. **Start before you build**: Crawl and benchmark the old site first. You can't protect rankings you haven't measured.
2. **Tick steps as you go**: Your progress saves in this browser automatically, so you can close the page and come back.
3. **Share with your team**: Use Copy progress to paste a status update into Slack, email or your project tool.
4. **Keep going after launch**: The last five steps matter most. Watch Search Console for two to four weeks after launch.

## Questions, answered

Also try the free [Webflow 301 Redirect Generator](https://webflowmigrationexpert.com/webflow-301-redirect-generator).

### What should a website migration checklist include?

A good website migration checklist covers five phases: auditing and benchmarking the old site, building and importing content, SEO setup, launch with 301 redirects and a new sitemap, and monitoring Search Console after launch. This checklist covers all 25 steps.

### How do I migrate a website to Webflow without losing SEO?

Crawl and benchmark the old site, keep URLs the same where you can, carry over titles, descriptions and alt text, add a 301 redirect for every URL that changes, submit the new sitemap and monitor Google Search Console for the first few weeks.

### How long does a Webflow migration take?

Most Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks. Larger sites with many CMS items or a full redesign can take longer.

### What is the most common Webflow migration mistake?

Missing 301 redirects. Old URLs that change without a redirect return 404 pages, which loses traffic and the rankings those pages had built up.

### Does this checklist work for WordPress, Wix and Squarespace?

Yes. The steps apply to any platform. The platform-specific details, like WordPress date-based URLs or Wix's missing export, are covered on each migration page of this site.

### Is the checklist free?

Yes, it's completely free with no sign-up. Your progress is stored only in your own browser.

## WordPress migration problems I solve before they cost you traffic

**Problem 01**

### Date-based and nested URLs

WordPress URLs like /2024/05/post-name/ can't be reproduced in Webflow, where CMS items live at /collection/item. I map every old URL and use Webflow's pattern-based 301 redirects so none of them break.

**Problem 02**

### Shortcodes and page builder markup

Elementor, Divi and shortcode content doesn't export cleanly. I clean it up so your posts arrive as proper rich text, not broken code.

**Problem 03**

### Plugin features

Popups, sliders, search and membership plugins each need a Webflow equivalent or an integration. I list them all during the audit, so nothing disappears at launch.

## What does a WordPress to Webflow migration expert do?

**Quick answer**

A WordPress to Webflow migration expert plans and runs the whole move for you so nothing breaks. A WordPress to Webflow migration has five parts: export your posts and pages (WordPress XML or CSV), rebuild the design in Webflow, import posts into Webflow CMS collections with categories and tags as reference fields, recreate SEO titles, descriptions and alt text from Yoast or Rank Math, and add 301 redirects for every URL that changes. Most WordPress to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks.

## Questions about hiring a WordPress to Webflow migration expert

### Why hire a WordPress to Webflow migration expert instead of doing it yourself?

Most traffic lost in a migration comes from broken URLs and missing SEO data, not from the design. A WordPress to Webflow migration expert maps every URL, sets up 301 redirects, carries over titles, descriptions and alt text, and watches Google Search Console after launch, so your rankings survive the move.

### Will I lose my Google rankings moving from WordPress to Webflow?

Not if the migration is planned properly. Every URL is mapped and 301 redirected, and your Yoast or Rank Math titles, descriptions and alt text are carried over. I also monitor Google Search Console after launch to catch crawl errors early.

### Can you migrate my WordPress blog to Webflow CMS?

Yes. Posts are exported from WordPress and bulk imported into Webflow CMS with their slugs, images, authors, categories and SEO fields.

### How long does a WordPress to Webflow migration take?

Most WordPress to Webflow migrations take 2 to 3 weeks. Very large blogs or sites with complex plugins can take longer, and you get an exact timeline with your quote.

### What happens to my WordPress plugins?

Webflow covers most plugin jobs natively: SEO settings, forms, hosting, security and backups. Anything else gets a Webflow feature, an integration or a small custom script.

### Can you move WooCommerce to Webflow?

Smaller stores can move to Webflow Ecommerce. For larger catalogs I'll recommend the best setup during the audit, before any work starts.
